# Qonvo

> An AI customer representative that runs on a business's own WhatsApp number.
> It answers customer questions in seconds, in the customer's language, by text
> or voice note, and takes action: booking appointments, taking orders and
> logging leads.

## What it is

Qonvo is a multi-tenant SaaS product for small and medium businesses that get
customer enquiries over WhatsApp. The business connects the WhatsApp number it
already uses, adds its own knowledge (opening hours, prices, policies, common
questions), and Qonvo answers on that number 24 hours a day.

It is fully managed. The business owner never runs or deploys code.

## Who it is for

Small and medium businesses whose customers message them on WhatsApp: salons,
dental and medical clinics, repair shops, restaurants, tutors, tradespeople,
clinics and local service businesses. It is most valuable where enquiries
arrive outside working hours and a slow reply loses the booking.

## What it does today

- Answers questions from knowledge the business supplies, and says plainly when
  a question falls outside what it knows rather than guessing.
- Detects the customer's language and replies in it. English, Urdu, Roman Urdu,
  Arabic, Hindi, Spanish and French all work.
- Understands voice notes and can reply with a voice note.
- Checks Google Calendar for genuine availability and books appointments,
  avoiding double-booking.
- Takes orders and captures leads, writing each to a Google Sheet the business
  controls.
- Hands a conversation over to a human. When the owner replies from their own
  phone, Qonvo detects it and goes quiet for that chat.
- Sends booking confirmations and a reminder before the appointment.

## What it does not do yet

- **Direct CRM sync is not available.** Leads are written to a Google Sheet,
  which can be imported into or connected to most CRMs. Direct integration is
  on the roadmap.
- No bulk messaging, broadcasts or marketing blasts. Qonvo replies to customers
  who message first. Outbound is limited to booking confirmations and reminders.

## Pricing

Qonvo is a paid product with a free trial. The trial runs for 14 days or 300
customer messages, whichever comes first, and requires no card. Subscription
pricing depends on conversation volume and is not published; prospective
customers are asked to get in touch for a quote.

## Privacy and isolation

Each business's data is isolated at the database level using row-level
security, so no tenant can read another tenant's conversations. Only the
account owner and the people they explicitly invite can see their
conversations.
